metadata.description: Images, videos, logos, voice-overs, music and design assets for Claude, made in your MegaScenes account with the price shown before every run.

plugins.name: megascenes
plugins.description: Images, videos, voice-overs and music from 140+ models (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs) in one place, with the exact price before every run. Generated in your MegaScenes account.

plugins.name: image
plugins.description: Create images from a description: photos, pictures, illustrations, art, characters and scenes in any aspect ratio. Generated in seconds and saved to your MegaScenes library.

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Create short video clips from a description of the scene and camera: reels, TikToks, shorts, ads, intros and stories. Generated with Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan and more.

plugins.name: logo-maker
plugins.description: Logo maker: design logo concepts from your brand name, business, style and colors. Up to four options per run, generated as image files you can download.

plugins.name: image-to-video
plugins.description: Image to video: animate a photo or picture from your MegaScenes library into a short clip with the motion and camera move you describe, generated in a few minutes.

plugins.name: video-editor
plugins.description: Video editor: edit a video from your MegaScenes library with a prompt. Restyle it, swap objects or the background, reframe it to 9:16 or 1:1, extend it with new footage, or lip-sync it to a voice track.

plugins.name: text-to-speech
plugins.description: Text to speech: turn a script into natural voice-overs and narration in many voices and languages, generated as audio files for videos, ads, podcasts and audiobooks.

plugins.name: music
plugins.description: Create original background music and soundtracks from a description of genre, mood, instruments and tempo, generated as audio files for videos, podcasts, games and ads.

plugins.name: sound-effects
plugins.description: Sound effects generator: describe a whoosh, footsteps, rain ambience, foley or a UI click and get the SFX file generated in seconds, for videos, games, apps and podcasts.

plugins.name: image-upscaler
plugins.description: Image upscaler: enlarge, enhance and sharpen an image from your MegaScenes library to 2x or 4x for print, wallpapers and 4K screens. The larger file is generated in seconds.

plugins.name: poster
plugins.description: Poster and flyer maker: event posters, flyers, sale announcements and menus generated with your headline and details spelled out correctly.

plugins.name: sticker-maker
plugins.description: Sticker maker: die-cut stickers of characters, pets, quotes and logos with a white border, kawaii or retro, generated ready to print or share.

plugins.name: emoji-maker
plugins.description: Emoji maker: custom emoji generated from your description in the glossy emoji look, for Slack, Discord and chats.

plugins.name: pixel-art-maker
plugins.description: Pixel art maker: 8-bit, 16-bit and isometric pixel art, game sprites, items and retro scenes generated from your description.

plugins.name: tattoo-generator
plugins.description: Tattoo generator: your idea turned into clean tattoo flash art in fine line, traditional, blackwork, Japanese or geometric style, generated as designs to take to your artist.

plugins.name: character-creator
plugins.description: Character creator: original characters for stories, games, comics and OCs, generated as portraits, full body art or turnaround sheets.

plugins.name: avatar-maker
plugins.description: Avatar maker: profile picture avatars (PFP) generated from a description in 3D cartoon, anime, flat, comic or pixel styles.

plugins.name: meme
plugins.description: Meme generator: original meme images about any situation, generated with your top and bottom captions spelled out.

plugins.name: thumbnail-maker
plugins.description: Thumbnail maker: eye-catching 16:9 YouTube thumbnails generated from your video title, with bold text on the image.

plugins.name: coloring-page-maker
plugins.description: Coloring page maker: printable coloring pages of any subject, simple for kids or detailed mandalas for adults, generated ready to print.

plugins.name: song
plugins.description: Song maker: an original song with vocals, generated from a theme or your own lyrics in the genre and mood you choose.

plugins.name: beat
plugins.description: Beat maker: instrumental hip hop, trap, lo-fi, drill, afrobeats and house beats generated at the tempo and mood you choose.

plugins.name: book-cover-maker
plugins.description: Book cover maker: covers for novels, ebooks and self-published KDP books, generated with your title and author name spelled out.

plugins.name: album-cover-maker
plugins.description: Album cover maker: square cover art for albums, EPs and singles, generated with the artist name and title, ready for Spotify and other streaming platforms.

plugins.name: invitation-maker
plugins.description: Invitation maker: wedding, birthday, baby shower and party invitations and greeting cards, generated with your details spelled out.

plugins.name: photo-editor
plugins.description: Photo editor: edit a photo or image from your MegaScenes library by describing the change. Swap the background, remove or add objects, change colors or style, retouch, or combine images.

plugins.name: background-remover
plugins.description: Background remover: cut the subject out of a photo or image from your MegaScenes library and get it on a transparent PNG, for product shots, stickers, profile pictures and designs.

plugins.name: business-card-maker
plugins.description: Business card maker: design the front of a business card with your name, job title and contact details spelled out, in the look you want, ready to print or share.

plugins.name: interior-design
plugins.description: Interior design: redesign a room in the style you want, from a photo of the room in your MegaScenes library or from a description. Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms and offices.

plugins.name: floor-plans
plugins.description: Floor plans: draw an illustrative floor plan of a home, apartment or office from the rooms you list, or redraw a sketch from your MegaScenes library. A visual guide, not a construction drawing.

plugins.name: trading-cards
plugins.description: Trading cards: design a custom trading card with your card name, stats and artwork, from a description or a photo in your MegaScenes library. Creatures, heroes, pets and game cards.

plugins.name: voice-changer
plugins.description: Voice changer: change the voice of a recording from your MegaScenes library to one of the ready-made voices, keeping its words, timing and emotion. It never copies a real person's voice.

plugins.name: vocal-remover
plugins.description: Vocal remover: split a song from your MegaScenes library into the instrumental and the vocals, two files for karaoke, covers, practice and remixes, or into six stems.

plugins.name: collage-maker
plugins.description: Collage maker: arrange 2 to 14 photos from your MegaScenes library into one collage in the layout and style you describe, for birthdays, trips, mood boards and social posts.

plugins.name: image-enhancer
plugins.description: Image enhancer: sharpen and restore a blurry, noisy or old photo from your MegaScenes library, with cleaner detail, less grain and restored faces, at a higher resolution.

plugins.name: graffiti-generator
plugins.description: Graffiti generator: turn a word or a name into graffiti art in wildstyle, bubble letters, 3D tags or throw-ups, on a wall, a train or a clean background.

plugins.name: professional-headshots
plugins.description: Professional headshots: a studio headshot of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library, with the same face and the outfit and background you pick, for profiles and resumes.

plugins.name: landscape-design
plugins.description: Landscape design: redesign a garden, backyard, patio, terrace or front yard in the style you want, from a photo in your MegaScenes library or from a description.

plugins.name: family-crests
plugins.description: Family crests: design a family crest or coat of arms with your surname and motto, and the symbols and colors you choose, for gifts, reunions, prints and engravings.

plugins.name: line-art
plugins.description: Line art: turn a photo from your MegaScenes library or a description into clean black outlines with no shading, for illustrations, tattoo stencils, embroidery, laser cutting and prints.

plugins.name: image-translator
plugins.description: Image translator: translate the text inside an image from your MegaScenes library and get the same image back with the translation in place, for comics, menus, signs, posters and slides.

plugins.name: audio-translator
plugins.description: Audio translator: translate a recording from your MegaScenes library into another language, spoken in the voices of the original speakers. Podcasts, voice-overs, lessons, up to 8 minutes.

plugins.name: channel-banners
plugins.description: Channel banners: design a YouTube channel banner with your channel name and tagline at 2560 x 1440, the text kept in the safe area that shows on phones, desktops and TVs.

plugins.name: flyer-maker
plugins.description: Flyer maker: design a flyer for your event, sale or business with the headline, date, place and offer in plain view, on a portrait page ready to print or post.

plugins.name: fantasy-maps
plugins.description: Fantasy maps: an illustrated map of a world you invent, for tabletop games, novels and campaigns, with kingdoms, coasts, mountains, forests, rivers and your place names.

plugins.name: photo-filters
plugins.description: Photo filters: turn a photo from your MegaScenes library into a new look, such as cartoon, anime, watercolor, oil painting, pencil sketch, pop art or vintage film, keeping its composition.

plugins.name: 3d-animation
plugins.description: 3D animation: a short clip in the look of a 3D animated film, from a description or a picture in your MegaScenes library, with stylized characters, soft lighting and a cinematic camera.

plugins.name: family-portraits
plugins.description: Family portraits: one portrait of your family from photos in your MegaScenes library, everyone with their own face, in the style and setting you choose, from studio to painted.

plugins.name: pet-portraits
plugins.description: Pet portraits: turn a photo of your pet from your MegaScenes library into a regal, Renaissance, watercolor or cartoon portrait, keeping its breed, colors and markings.

plugins.name: photoshoot-generator
plugins.description: Photoshoot generator: new photos of yourself from your own photo in your MegaScenes library, with the same face in the scene and outfit you choose, for profiles, portfolios and posts.

plugins.name: hairstyle-try-on
plugins.description: Hairstyle try on: see a new haircut or hair color on your own photo from your MegaScenes library before the salon, with the same face: a bob, bangs, a buzz cut, waves or a new shade.

plugins.name: monogram-maker
plugins.description: Monogram maker: design a monogram from your initials for weddings, stationery, embroidery, signet rings and personal brands, in classic, modern or floral styles.

plugins.name: social-media-posts
plugins.description: Social media posts: design a post with your message on it, a square feed post, a tall story or a pin, for an announcement, a quote, a sale or a tip.

plugins.name: banner-maker
plugins.description: Banner maker: design a banner with your headline for a website, a store, an event or a sale, in a wide, square or tall format.

plugins.name: ringtone-maker
plugins.description: Ringtone maker: an original ringtone or notification tune of about 30 seconds from a style and mood, a catchy loop, marimba, chiptune, lo-fi or orchestral.
